builtInReadOnly: Built-in characters are read-only — duplicate first
description: Reusable personas. Each character carries its own system prompt, model, MCP subset, and skills. Pick one when you start a new chat.

account.description: Pin sends from this character to a specific provider account. Inherit uses the session / settings default.
account.label: Account override

avatarImage.large: Avatar image is large — a smaller image keeps the character data lean.

browserToolsToggle.description: Let this character drive the in-app preview browser (navigate, snapshot, click, type, read console/network). Desktop only.
browserToolsToggle.label: Agent browser tools

allowedToolIds.description: Restrict which registered native Anthropic tools this character can use. Uncheck all to let every registered tool through.
allowedToolIds.empty: No native Anthropic tools registered yet — install the Computer Use plugin to expose computer / bash / text_editor.
allowedToolIds.label: Allowed native tools

chatConsentMode.description: How the in-chat canUseTool modal behaves. Independent of the Rust gate — both can prompt.
chatConsentMode.label: Chat-side prompt behaviour

requireConsent.description: Force every driving Computer Use call to the consent overlay for this character, regardless of Settings → Automation → Permissions. Useful for new characters whose behaviour you're still learning.
requireConsent.label: Always ask before each call

screenOffMode.description: Keep Computer Use working when the monitor is off or asleep (the session must stay unlocked) by routing capture through a bundled virtual display. Requires the virtual-display driver — set it up under Settings → Automation. Off by default.
screenOffMode.label: Screen-off mode (Windows)

computerUseTarget.description: Where this character's computer-use actions run. Pick a configured cua sandbox to run them in an isolated Docker desktop instead of this machine. Manage sandboxes under Settings → Automation → Sandboxes.
computerUseTarget.label: Execution target

editor.mcpServersHint: Leave all unselected to mean "use every enabled server".
editor.knowledgeBasesEmptyHint: No reusable library is bound to this Agent.
editor.knowledgeBasesHint: Bind one or more reusable libraries. Retrieval searches all selected libraries independently.

memoryPolicy.description: Choose which long-term memory actions this Agent may perform and which scopes it may access.
memoryPolicy.globalCeiling: App-wide memory and privacy settings remain the upper bound. This policy can restrict access, but cannot grant access disabled globally or for the current session.
memoryPolicy.title: Memory policy

routing.description: Choose separate targets for planning, execution, and lightweight utility work. Model aliases and Auto are supported by the existing router.
routing.title: Semantic model routing

execution.envDescription: Plain values are stored with the Agent. Secret values are written to the device keyring; only an opaque reference is saved or exported.

platforms.description: Restrict this character to specific platforms. Leave all off to show it everywhere.
platforms.title: Available on

enable.description: Replace SDK builtins with sandbox_* equivalents for this character.
enable.label: Sandbox Bash / Edit / Write

tier.description: Beats the app-wide default. Inherit defers to Settings → Sandbox.
tier.label: Sandbox tier

editor.skillsHint: Order matters — earlier skills are appended first to the system prompt.

twinBinding.enableCitationsHint: Attach formatted citations for the retrieved chunks to the Twin-RAG sources (display only — never changes the prompt).
twinBinding.enableCorrectiveFilterHint: Drop low-relevance retrieved chunks with a heuristic grader before they reach the prompt.
twinBinding.enableHybridHint: Blend BM25 keyword retrieval with the vector search so verbatim names, ids, and file references aren't missed.
twinBinding.enableQueryExpansionHint: Widen recall with synonym expansion (and optional LLM HyDE/step-back when configured in twin runtime settings).
twinBinding.enableRagHint: Retrieve top-K twin chunks at send time and inject them into the system prompt.
twinBinding.enableStyleFewShotHint: Pick representative writing samples from the twin profile for tone matching.
twinBinding.newTwinIdHint: Letters, digits, and underscores. Must be unique across your characters.
twinBinding.unbindBody: The twin's data is preserved — only this character's link to it is removed.
twinBinding.unboundDescription: Link this character to a Digital Twin to inject RAG-retrieved chunks and writing-style few-shots into every send.

voice.description: Optional per-character voice for read-aloud. Inherits the global speech settings when left on Inherit.
voice.title: Voice
